answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, released only after three unrelated confirmations, no identity may audit its own recruit. What survives to the jade is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Work waits on the oasis until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the prism of the next round.
